reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 10 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pistons.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pistons.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 83 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.

analyst.text: This is a rematch three days after Detroit won 122-111 despite 44 points from Anthony Davis, who then criticised the Wizards' defense and rebounding in public. Washington reportedly want to see Davis play 20-30 games before deciding on an extension, so every night is a showcase. Detroit are without Jalen Duren (hamstring) for at least two more weeks. Davis's motivation is real, but a frustrated team on a long losing run is the weaker mental side; the lean stays with Detroit.
